summary: Clarke County tower near Thomasville, administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission; NHLR-registered May 2022; behind a posted gate; little history found.

facts.status_note: Register describes the tower in the present tense as located behind a gate; no condition report found.

access.note: Behind a gate posted with no trespassing signs, per the 2022 NHLR description; no visiting arrangement found.

events.note: Date registered May 22, 2022; nominated by Jackson E. Knight; register number US 1594, AL 78

evidence.supports: administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission
register coordinates, the same as the blog's, so one tower
blog coordinates match the register, so the blog covers the same tower
register says little is known about this tower
evidence.quote: Little is known about this Clarke County tower.

evidence.supports: register says the tower sits behind a gate with no-trespassing notices
evidence.quote: It is located behind a gate that is posted with no trespassing signs.

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts lists Thomasville in Clarke County under the Alabama Forestry Commission
blog places the lookout beside Al 5 north of Thomasville
evidence.quote: Thomasville Lookout is Located beside Al 5 North of Thomasville, Al

evidence.supports: blog says little other information is available
evidence.quote: At the time of this video I have little other information to go on.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Jackson's Ramblings gives Al 146; the NHLR entry gives AL 78. The NHLR number is kept.

notes_for_editor: Register gives coordinates, elevation, administrator, registration date and the gate note; it gives no height, build date or staffing. Forest Lookouts entry is a header with county and agency only. One WebSearch returned nothing on this tower; the other hits were a Grove Hill tower in a different town and an unrelated 321-ft communications tower on Old Hwy 5 S, neither used.
